senses.def: (genetics) abnormal complement of sex hormones in a male resulting in Klinefelter's syndrome
Having an aneuploidy in the configuration of chromosomes by having an extra Y chromosome.

syndrome in males that is characterized by small testes and long legs and enlarged breasts and reduced sperm production and mental retardation; a genetic defect in which an extra X chromosome (XXY) is present in the male
A sex chromosome anomaly in which a male has an extra X chromosome and an extra Y chromosome.
